title: Inpage Navigation
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a Business User, I want to have flexible inpage navigation components with category nodes that can be displayed as both a grid and slider, so that I can present categorized content in an engaging and adaptable way.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

These requirements apply to all 3 variants of Inpage Navigation

* **Display Options:**

    * Category nodes can be displayed in grid layout
    * Category nodes can be displayed in slider format
    * Users can switch between display modes
    * Optional Headings (Caption, Headline, Subline) can be displayed
    * Category nodes can have flags
    
* **Category Node Features:**

    * Each node contains an image and title
    * Each node is linked to a category
    * Not part of this MVP:
    
        * ~~The user can choose whether to manually select categories and create nodes, or whether they should be created automatically (recommendations maybe not part of MVP?)~~
        
            * ~~Show all subcategories from level X~~
            * ~~Most popular categories/subcategories~~
            * ~~Category recommendations based on~~
            
                * ~~the product viewed~~
                * ~~recently viewed categories and products~~
                
            
        
    * Background color of nodes is customizable (We therefore recommend using transparent images)
    * Flags can be added manually
    * System can automatically assign flags based on predefined rules
    
* **"Sale" Mode:**

    * One-click activation of "Sale" mode
    * Visual appearance of nodes changes in "Sale" mode
    * Sale-specific styling can be predefined
    

---
